$comment: pix_gpu_counters_list on an Intel Arc B580 (driver 32.0.101.8991) with PIX 2606.18-preview, replaying the NVIDIA-captured baseline fixture with IGNORE_INCOMPATIBILITIES, 2026-09-14. 22 D3D counters plus 259 INTEL plugin counters in 16 groups; units live in the descriptions.

counters.name: AMFS 4x4 Shading Request
counters.description: INTEL: Number of Shading Request (evaluate) messages processed by AMFS

counters.name: AMFS Cache Hit
counters.description: INTEL: Number of hits in the AMFS cache

counters.name: AMFS Cache Miss
counters.description: INTEL: Number of cache misses in AMFS

counters.name: AMFS L3 Access
counters.description: INTEL: Number of AMFS access to Device Cache

counters.name: AMFS L3 Hit
counters.description: INTEL: Number of AMFS hits in Device Cache

counters.name: AMFS L3 Write
counters.description: INTEL: Number of AMFS writes to Device Cache

counters.name: AMFS Stall All Input
counters.description: INTEL: Percentage of time in which AMFS stalls at both of the color pipe inputs

counters.name: AMFS Stall Any Input
counters.description: INTEL: Percentage of time in which AMFS stalls at any of the color pipe inputs

counters.name: Async GpGpu Thread Exit Count
counters.description: INTEL: Number of Async GPGPU EOT messages received

counters.name: Async GpGpu Threadgroup Count
counters.description: INTEL: Number of Async GPGPU threadgroups dispatched

counters.name: AVG GPU Core Frequency
counters.description: INTEL: Average GPU Core Frequency in the measurement.

counters.name: Clipper Input Available
counters.description: INTEL: Percentage of time in which Clipper has input available (from Vertex Shader or SOL)

counters.name: Clipper Input Vertex
counters.description: INTEL: Number of Clipper input vertices

counters.name: Clipper Output Ready
counters.description: INTEL: Percentage of time in which Clipper output ready

counters.name: Clipper Primitive Cull
counters.description: INTEL: Number of Clipper early cull primitives

counters.name: Clipper Primitive Far Near Clip
counters.description: INTEL: Number of primitives clipped by Clipper due to near/far planes

counters.name: Clipper Primitive Output
counters.description: INTEL: Number of primitives going out of Clipper, must clip plus the trivial accept. Must clip primitives are counted one time only.

counters.name: Clipper Primitives In
counters.description: Number of primitives sent to the clipper. Equivalent to the number of times the clipper was executed. This includes additional primitives generated by the Geometry Shader if applicable. If the rasterizer is disabled then this will be 0.

counters.name: Clipper Primitives Out
counters.description: Number of primitives generated by the clipper. Equivalent to the number of primitives that were rendered. This value may be larger or smaller than Clipper Invocations because the clipper may split primitives into multiple primitives and/or cull other primitives entirely.

counters.name: Clipper Transaction Output
counters.description: INTEL: Number of elements pushed by Clipper into Stripsfan stage

counters.name: Color L3 Access
counters.description: INTEL: Number of Device Cache requests resulting from color local cache misses

counters.name: Color L3 Hit
counters.description: INTEL: Number of Device Cache requests resulting from color local cache miss which hits in Device Cache

counters.name: Color Pipe Cache Latency1 Stall
counters.description: INTEL: Percentage of time in which Color Pipeline stalled due to MultiSampling Cache latency hiding structure full

counters.name: Color Pipe Cache Latency2 Stall
